text:
Type: embossed ceramic table vase
Use: holding flowers or decor; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a table, shelf or console
Style: mid-century modern, rustic, bohemian
Materials: glazed stoneware with embossed relief
Colors: soft pale yellow-green, cream rim
Shape: rounded cylinder with domed shoulders, raised feather leaf pattern, wide cream collar, medium size
Feel: soft, natural, calm
Goes with: light wood, linen, sage and cream; mid-century or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Rustic Vase, 8.66"H, Neutral
product.description: The reactive glaze used on this 100% stoneware vase is embossed with tonal feather details that make each item unique. Feature this vase alone or with seasonal flowers. 5.59" diameter x 8.66"H 100% stoneware This mid-century vase with a reactive glaze finish has a feather design boasts a gold-finished top. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
